trajectory.center_rule: mean of all ten archived target positions

reference_time: end of last active-source sensor acquisition window; CV background completion recorded separately
phase_rule: The target is at the same reference phase at each mode-specific acquisition end. Every speed uses the same 180 phases. These are phase-matched acquisition windows, not a claim of 180 consecutive updates per revolution.

controls_explained.synchronous: All source and sensor fields evaluated at reference time. Retains finite-array spatial approximation.
controls_explained.source_slot_only: Each source sampled at its nominal mean sensor time, with all sensors simultaneous within that slot. Isolates sensitivity to within-slot timing.
controls_explained.ideal_rho: Exact geometric source-to-array relative vector at each source mean time; tests only cross-source registration inconsistency.

zero_speed_rule: Each circle reference position is treated as a separate stationary case. The zero-speed family is the static baseline around the circle.
source_model: point dipoles, fixed source strength and geometry from frozen baseline
statistics: Mean, median, p95 (linear quantile), maximum across all 180 phases. Phase spread is not a statistical confidence interval.
scope: Kinematic sensitivity simulation only. No hardware or clinical speed validation. Nominal sensor read order and midpoint timestamps are assumptions, not verified firmware events.
